suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914 affects Kotlin build-cache metadata deserialization. This project includes kotlin-stdlib only as a runtime dependency; it does not include the Kotlin compiler or build-cache implementation.
CVE-2026-0994 is in Python's google.protobuf.json_format.ParseDict(). protobuf-java is the separate Java implementation and does not contain that Python parser.

CVE-2025-10492 affects JasperReports Library Community Edition through 7.0.3. The project's JasperReports 7.0.8 is outside the affected range; this narrowly scoped suppression avoids the CPE match being reported as vulnerable despite the fixed version.
